name: KALIUM BROMATUM
key_symptoms: Vomiting, with intense thirst, after each meal. Persistent hiccough (Sulph ac).
Suicidal mania with tremulousness. Face flushed. Numb feeling in head. Brain-fag. Coryza with tendency to extension into throat.
Spasmodic croup. Reflex cough during pregnancy. Dry, fatiguing, hacking cough at night.
Fidgety hands; busy twitching of fingers. Jerking and twitching of muscles.

mind_symptoms: Profound, melancholic delusion; feeling of moral deficiency; religious depression; delusions of conspiracies against him. Imagines he is singled out as an object of divine wrath. Loss of memory. Must do something-move about; gets fidgety (Tarant). Fear of being poisoned (Hyos). Amnesic aphasia; can pronounce any word told, but cannot speak otherwise. Night terrors. Horrid illusions. Active delirium.
head_symptoms: Suicidal mania with tremulousness. Face flushed. Numb feeling in head. Brain-fag. Coryza with tendency to extension into throat.

gi_symptoms: Vomiting, with intense thirst, after each meal. Persistent hiccough (Sulph ac).
urinary_symptoms: Sensibility of urethra diminished. Urine profuse, with thirst. Diabetes (Phos ac).
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Fidgety hands; busy twitching of fingers. Jerking and twitching of muscles.
skin_symptoms: Acne of face, pustules. Itching; worse on chest, shoulders, and face. Anæsthesia of skin. Psoriasis.
sleep_symptoms: Restless sleep. Extreme drowsiness. Sleeplessness due to worry and grief and sexual excess. Night terrors. Grinding teeth in sleep. Horrible dreams. Somnambulism.

source.title: KALIUM BROMATUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
